--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- UPGRADE SERVICE · mejoras, velocidad, sprint y stamina
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local EconomyService = require(script.Parent.EconomyService)

local UpgradeService = {}

-- stamina por jugador: [userId] = { Value, Sprinting, LastDrain }
local stamina = {}
local lastAppliedSpeed = {} -- [userId] = número aplicado por última vez

function UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, upgradeId)
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	if not data then return 0 end
	return data.Upgrades[upgradeId] or 0
end

function UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player)
	return Config.StaminaMax + 20 * UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Stamina")
end

function UpgradeService.GetBaseSpeed(player)
	return Config.BaseWalkSpeed + 1.5 * UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "Speed")
end

-- Velocidad efectiva: base × modificador del paquete + sprint
function UpgradeService.EffectiveSpeed(player)
	local mult = player:GetAttribute("SpeedMult") or 1
	local speed = UpgradeService.GetBaseSpeed(player)
	local st = stamina[player.UserId]
	if st and st.Sprinting and st.Value > 0 then
		speed += Config.SprintBoost
	end
	return speed * mult
end

function UpgradeService.InitPlayer(player)
	stamina[player.UserId] = { Value = UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player), Sprinting = false, LastDrain = 0 }
	player:SetAttribute("Stamina", stamina[player.UserId].Value)
	player:SetAttribute("StaminaMax", UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player))
	player:SetAttribute("GPSLevel", UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, "GPS"))
	player:SetAttribute("SpeedMult", 1)
end

function UpgradeService.ApplyCharacter(player)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	hum.UseJumpPower = true
	hum.JumpPower = 50
	hum.WalkSpeed = UpgradeService.EffectiveSpeed(player)
	lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] = hum.WalkSpeed
end

function UpgradeService.SetSprinting(player, flag)
	local st = stamina[player.UserId]
	if st then
		st.Sprinting = flag == true
	end
end

-- Bucle global: drena/regenera stamina y aplica la velocidad
function UpgradeService.Start()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local st = stamina[player.UserId]
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if st and hum then
				local maxSt = UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player)
				local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
				if st.Sprinting and st.Value > 0 and moving then
					st.Value = math.max(0, st.Value - Config.StaminaDrain * dt)
					st.LastDrain = os.clock()
					if st.Value <= 0 then
						st.Sprinting = false
					end
				elseif os.clock() - st.LastDrain > Config.StaminaRegenDelay then
					st.Value = math.min(maxSt, st.Value + Config.StaminaRegen * dt)
				end
				-- atributos para el HUD (solo cuando cambia el entero)
				local shown = math.floor(st.Value + 0.5)
				if player:GetAttribute("Stamina") ~= shown then
					player:SetAttribute("Stamina", shown)
				end
				if player:GetAttribute("StaminaMax") ~= maxSt then
					player:SetAttribute("StaminaMax", maxSt)
				end
				-- aplicar velocidad solo cuando cambia
				local speed = UpgradeService.EffectiveSpeed(player)
				if lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] ~= speed then
					hum.WalkSpeed = speed
					lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] = speed
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Compra de mejoras (validación en servidor)
function UpgradeService.Purchase(player, upgradeId)
	local def = Config.Upgrades[upgradeId]
	if not def then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Mejora desconocida" }
	end
	local level = UpgradeService.GetLevel(player, upgradeId)
	if level >= def.MaxLevel then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Nivel máximo alcanzado" }
	end
	local cost = def.Costs[level + 1]
	if not EconomyService.SpendMoney(player, cost) then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Dinero insuficiente ($" .. cost .. ")" }
	end
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	data.Upgrades[upgradeId] = level + 1
	EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	if upgradeId == "GPS" then
		player:SetAttribute("GPSLevel", level + 1)
	end
	if upgradeId == "Stamina" then
		local st = stamina[player.UserId]
		if st then
			player:SetAttribute("StaminaMax", UpgradeService.GetMaxStamina(player))
		end
	end
	return { Ok = true, Msg = def.Name .. " → nivel " .. (level + 1), Level = level + 1 }
end

function UpgradeService.Cleanup(player)
	stamina[player.UserId] = nil
	lastAppliedSpeed[player.UserId] = nil
end

return UpgradeService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- VEHICLE SERVICE · compra y generación de vehículos
-- 🚲 Bici · 🛴 Scooter · 🏍️ Moto · 🚗 Coche
--
-- Cada vehículo es un MODELO (ServerStorage/DeliveryModels/<Id>)
-- con el comportamiento Behaviors/Vehicle. Si la plantilla no existe
-- o está vacía, se construyen bloques placeholder conducibles.
--============================================================
local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local Server = script.Parent
local EconomyService = require(Server.EconomyService)
local EntitySpawner = require(Server.EntitySpawner)

local VehicleService = {}

local function vehiclesFolder()
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryVehicles")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "DeliveryVehicles"
		folder.Parent = workspace
	end
	return folder
end

function VehicleService.GetPlayerVehicle(player)
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryVehicles")
	if not folder then return nil end
	for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then
			return m
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Compra (RemoteFunction)
function VehicleService.Purchase(player, vehicleId)
	local def = Config.Vehicles[vehicleId]
	if not def then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Vehículo desconocido" }
	end
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Datos no cargados" }
	end
	if data.Vehicles[vehicleId] then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Ya lo tienes" }
	end
	if not EconomyService.SpendMoney(player, def.Price) then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Dinero insuficiente ($" .. def.Price .. ")" }
	end
	data.Vehicles[vehicleId] = true
	EconomyService.SavePlayer(player)
	return { Ok = true, Msg = def.Name .. " comprado" }
end

-- Generar vehículo junto al jugador (RemoteFunction)
function VehicleService.Spawn(player, vehicleId)
	local def = Config.Vehicles[vehicleId]
	if not def then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Vehículo desconocido" }
	end
	local data = EconomyService.GetData(player)
	if not data or not data.Vehicles[vehicleId] then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "No tienes este vehículo" }
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return { Ok = false, Msg = "Personaje no disponible" }
	end

	-- destruir el vehículo anterior del jugador
	local old = VehicleService.GetPlayerVehicle(player)
	if old then old:Destroy() end

	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn(vehicleId, {
		MaxSpeed = def.MaxSpeed,
		Torque = def.Torque,
		TurnSpeed = def.TurnSpeed,
		OwnerUserId = player.UserId,
	}, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(7, 3, 0))
	model.Parent = vehiclesFolder()
	return { Ok = true, Msg = def.Name .. " listo" }
end

function VehicleService.Cleanup(player)
	local v = VehicleService.GetPlayerVehicle(player)
	if v then v:Destroy() end
end

return VehicleService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- CLIENT MAIN · Delivery: 60 Seconds
-- Entrada de sprint, HUD y comunicación con el servidor.
-- (Con diagnósticos paso a paso: revisa Ver → Output si algo falla)
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
print("[Delivery60] Cliente: iniciando…")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
print("[Delivery60] Cliente: DeliveryShared OK")

local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)
print("[Delivery60] Cliente: Remotes OK")

-- cargar módulos de interfaz (con diagnóstico claro)
local okHUD, HUD = pcall(function()
	return require(script.Parent.HUD)
end)
if not okHUD then
	warn("[Delivery60] Cliente: ERROR cargando el módulo HUD → " .. tostring(HUD))
	warn("[Delivery60] ¿Existe StarterPlayerScripts/DeliveryClient/HUD como ModuleScript?")
	return
end
print("[Delivery60] Cliente: módulo HUD OK")

local okShop, ShopUI = pcall(function()
	return require(script.Parent.ShopUI)
end)
if not okShop then
	warn("[Delivery60] Cliente: ERROR cargando el módulo ShopUI → " .. tostring(ShopUI))
	return
end
print("[Delivery60] Cliente: módulo ShopUI OK")

local okBuild, errBuild = pcall(function()
	HUD.Build()
	ShopUI.Build()
end)
if not okBuild then
	warn("[Delivery60] Cliente: ERROR construyendo la interfaz → " .. tostring(errBuild))
	return
end
print("[Delivery60] Cliente: interfaz construida OK")

-- eventos del servidor → HUD
Remotes.DeliveryPopup.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	HUD.Popup(data)
end)

Remotes.EventAnnounce.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(icon, name, desc, duration)
	HUD.Event(icon, name, desc, duration)
end)

Remotes.OpenShop.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	ShopUI.Open()
end)

-- 🏃 sprint con Shift (el servidor valida la stamina)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		Remotes.Sprint:FireServer(true)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		Remotes.Sprint:FireServer(false)
	end
end)

-- bucle de render del HUD (si Tick falla, avisa sin spamear)
local lastTickError = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(HUD.Tick, player)
	if not ok and os.clock() - lastTickError > 5 then
		lastTickError = os.clock()
		warn("[Delivery60] Cliente: ERROR en HUD.Tick → " .. tostring(err))
	end
end)

print("[Delivery60] Cliente listo 📦")

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- HUD · temporizador superior, ⏱️ reloj sobre la cabeza, tarjeta
-- del paquete (con ⭐ dificultad), destino (baliza para todos +
-- haz guía con GPS N2), dinero/reputación/nivel, stamina,
-- popups y banner de eventos. Todo construido por código.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local HUD = {}

local refs = {}
local beacon = nil
local beamAnchor, beam, attA = nil, nil, nil
local clockGui, clockLabel = nil, nil
local popupToken = 0

local COLORS = {
	Panel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 30),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245),
	Good = Color3.fromRGB(150, 240, 180),
	Warn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120),
	Bad = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 100),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
}

local function round(inst, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 10)
	c.Parent = inst
end

local function makeLabel(parent, name, size, pos, textSize, font)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = name
	l.Size = size
	l.Position = pos
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextColor3 = COLORS.Text
	l.Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham
	l.TextSize = textSize
	l.Text = ""
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local function makePanel(parent, name, size, pos)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = name
	f.Size = size
	f.Position = pos
	f.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Panel
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.Visible = false
	round(f, 12)
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

function HUD.Build()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "DeliveryHUD"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	refs.Gui = gui

	-- ⏱️ Temporizador (arriba, centro)
	local timerFrame = makePanel(gui, "Timer", UDim2.fromOffset(220, 70), UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0, 14))
	local timerScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	timerScale.Parent = timerFrame
	local timeLabel = makeLabel(timerFrame, "Time", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), 44, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	timeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	refs.TimerFrame = timerFrame
	refs.TimeLabel = timeLabel
	refs.TimerScale = timerScale

	-- 📍 Destino (bajo el temporizador)
	local destFrame = makePanel(gui, "Dest", UDim2.fromOffset(320, 36), UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0, 92))
	local destLabel = makeLabel(destFrame, "Label", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), 17, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	destLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	refs.DestFrame = destFrame
	refs.DestLabel = destLabel

	-- 📦 Tarjeta del paquete (arriba izquierda)
	local card = makePanel(gui, "PackageCard", UDim2.fromOffset(250, 92), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14))
	local icon = makeLabel(card, "Icon", UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8), 40, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	icon.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	local pkgName = makeLabel(card, "Name", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(72, 10), 18, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	local pkgDesc = makeLabel(card, "Desc", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 46), UDim2.fromOffset(72, 36), 12, Enum.Font.Gotham)
	pkgDesc.TextWrapped = true
	pkgDesc.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	pkgDesc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 192, 198)
	local healthLabel = makeLabel(card, "Health", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(72, 72), 13, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	healthLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.Bad
	refs.Card = card
	refs.CardIcon = icon
	refs.CardName = pkgName
	refs.CardDesc = pkgDesc
	refs.HealthLabel = healthLabel

	-- 💰⭐🏆 Dinero, reputación y nivel (abajo derecha)
	local moneyFrame = makePanel(gui, "Money", UDim2.fromOffset(300, 40), UDim2.new(1, -314, 1, -54))
	moneyFrame.Visible = true
	local moneyLabel = makeLabel(moneyFrame, "Label", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), 17, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	moneyLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	moneyLabel.Text = "💰 $0  ⭐ 50  🏆 Nv. 1"
	refs.MoneyLabel = moneyLabel

	-- ⚡ Barra de stamina (sobre el dinero)
	local stamBg = Instance.new("Frame")
	stamBg.Name = "StaminaBg"
	stamBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 12)
	stamBg.Position = UDim2.new(1, -314, 1, -72)
	stamBg.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Panel
	stamBg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	stamBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	round(stamBg, 6)
	stamBg.Parent = gui
	local stamFill = Instance.new("Frame")
	stamFill.Name = "Fill"
	stamFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	stamFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 140)
	stamFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	round(stamFill, 6)
	stamFill.Parent = stamBg
	refs.StaminaFill = stamFill

	-- 🃏 Popup central (entrega asignada / éxito / fallo / avisos)
	local popup = makePanel(gui, "Popup", UDim2.fromOffset(430, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, -215, 0.32, 0))
	popup.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	local popupTitle = makeLabel(popup, "Title", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), 26, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	popupTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	local popupLines = makeLabel(popup, "Lines", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 56), 16, Enum.Font.Gotham)
	popupLines.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	popupLines.TextWrapped = true
	popupLines.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 212, 216)
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14)
	pad.Parent = popup
	refs.Popup = popup
	refs.PopupTitle = popupTitle
	refs.PopupLines = popupLines

	-- 🌀 Banner de evento (arriba, bajo el destino)
	local banner = makePanel(gui, "EventBanner", UDim2.fromOffset(430, 42), UDim2.new(0.5, -215, 0, 136))
	local bannerLabel = makeLabel(banner, "Label", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), 17, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	bannerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	refs.Banner = banner
	refs.BannerLabel = bannerLabel
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Popups
------------------------------------------------------------
local POPUP_COLORS = {
	Assigned = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
	Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
	Fail = Color3.fromRGB(224, 90, 80),
	Info = Color3.fromRGB(90, 110, 140),
}

function HUD.Popup(data)
	local popup = refs.Popup
	if not popup then return end
	popup.BackgroundColor3 = POPUP_COLORS[data.Kind] or COLORS.Panel
	popup.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	refs.PopupTitle.Text = data.Title or ""
	refs.PopupLines.Text = table.concat(data.Lines or {}, "\n")
	popup.Visible = true
	popupToken += 1
	local myToken = popupToken
	task.delay(3.4, function()
		if popupToken == myToken then
			popup.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Banner de evento
------------------------------------------------------------
function HUD.Event(icon, name, desc, duration)
	local banner = refs.Banner
	if not banner then return end
	refs.BannerLabel.Text = icon .. " " .. name .. " — " .. desc
	banner.Visible = true
	task.delay(math.min(duration or 8, 10), function()
		banner.Visible = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ⏱️ Reloj flotante sobre la cabeza del repartidor (60 → 0)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function ensureClock(char, on)
	if on and char then
		local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not head then return end
		if not clockGui or clockGui.Parent ~= head then
			if clockGui then clockGui:Destroy() end
			clockGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			clockGui.Name = "DeliveryClock"
			clockGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 42)
			clockGui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
			clockGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
			clockLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			clockLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			clockLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			clockLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			clockLabel.TextScaled = true
			clockLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
			clockLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.Good
			clockLabel.Text = "⏱️ 60.0"
			clockLabel.Parent = clockGui
			clockGui.Parent = head
		end
	elseif clockGui then
		clockGui:Destroy()
		clockGui = nil
		clockLabel = nil
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Baliza luminosa en el destino (para TODOS, sin GPS)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function ensureBeacon(on, destPos)
	if on and destPos then
		if not beacon then
			beacon = Instance.new("Part")
			beacon.Name = "DestBeacon"
			beacon.Anchored = true
			beacon.CanCollide = false
			beacon.CanQuery = false
			beacon.CanTouch = false
			beacon.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			beacon.Transparency = 0.35
			beacon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90)
			beacon.Size = Vector3.new(3, 90, 3)
			beacon.Parent = workspace
		end
		beacon.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0))
	elseif beacon then
		beacon:Destroy()
		beacon = nil
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Haz guía del jugador al destino (GPS nivel 2+)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function ensureBeam(on, destPos, char)
	if on and destPos and char then
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		if not beamAnchor then
			beamAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
			beamAnchor.Name = "GPSBeamAnchor"
			beamAnchor.Anchored = true
			beamAnchor.CanCollide = false
			beamAnchor.CanQuery = false
			beamAnchor.CanTouch = false
			beamAnchor.Transparency = 1
			beamAnchor.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local attB = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attB.Parent = beamAnchor
			beam = Instance.new("Beam")
			beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255))
			beam.Width0 = 0.5
			beam.Width1 = 0.5
			beam.FaceCamera = true
			beam.Attachment1 = attB
			beam.Parent = beamAnchor
			beamAnchor.Parent = workspace
		end
		beamAnchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
		if not attA or attA.Parent ~= hrp then
			if attA then attA:Destroy() end
			attA = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attA.Parent = hrp
			beam.Attachment0 = attA
		end
	else
		if beam then beam:Destroy() beam = nil end
		if beamAnchor then beamAnchor:Destroy() beamAnchor = nil end
		if attA then attA:Destroy() attA = nil end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tick por frame: temporizador, reloj, destino, stamina, dinero
------------------------------------------------------------
function HUD.Tick(player)
	if not refs.Gui then return end
	local state = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryState")
	local hasDelivery = state ~= nil and state ~= "None"
	local char = player.Character

	refs.TimerFrame.Visible = hasDelivery
	refs.DestFrame.Visible = hasDelivery

	if hasDelivery then
		local endsAt = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryEndsAt") or 0
		local remaining = math.max(0, endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		local timeText = string.format("%.1f", remaining)
		local timeColor
		if remaining > 20 then
			timeColor = COLORS.Good
			refs.TimerScale.Scale = 1
		elseif remaining > 10 then
			timeColor = COLORS.Warn
			refs.TimerScale.Scale = 1
		else
			timeColor = COLORS.Bad
			refs.TimerScale.Scale = 1 + 0.07 * math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 7))
		end
		refs.TimeLabel.Text = timeText
		refs.TimeLabel.TextColor3 = timeColor

		-- ⏱️ reloj sobre la cabeza
		ensureClock(char, true)
		if clockLabel then
			clockLabel.Text = "⏱️ " .. timeText
			clockLabel.TextColor3 = timeColor
		end

		local destName = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestName") or "?"
		local destPos = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestPos")
		local hasPos = typeof(destPos) == "Vector3"
		local gps = player:GetAttribute("GPSLevel") or 0

		local distText = ""
		if gps >= 1 and hasPos then
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then
				distText = " · " .. math.floor((hrp.Position - destPos).Magnitude + 0.5) .. " studs"
			end
		end
		refs.DestLabel.Text = "📍 " .. destName .. distText

		-- baliza para todos + haz guía con GPS nivel 2
		ensureBeacon(hasPos, destPos)
		ensureBeam(gps >= 2 and hasPos, destPos, char)

		-- tarjeta del paquete con dificultad
		refs.Card.Visible = true
		refs.CardIcon.Text = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryPackageIcon") or "📦"
		local pkgName = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryPackage") or "Paquete"
		local diff = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDifficulty") or 1
		refs.CardName.Text = pkgName .. " " .. string.rep("⭐", math.clamp(diff, 1, 3))
		refs.CardDesc.Text = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryPackageDesc") or ""
		if state == "Dropped" then
			refs.CardDesc.Text = "📦 ¡En el suelo! Recógelo."
		elseif state == "ChickenOut" then
			refs.CardDesc.Text = "🐔 ¡El pollo escapó! Atrápalo."
		end
		local health = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryHealth") or -1
		refs.HealthLabel.Text = health >= 0 and ("❤️ x" .. health) or ""
	else
		refs.Card.Visible = false
		ensureClock(nil, false)
		ensureBeacon(false)
		ensureBeam(false)
	end

	-- stamina
	local st = player:GetAttribute("Stamina") or 100
	local stMax = player:GetAttribute("StaminaMax") or 100
	refs.StaminaFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(st / math.max(1, stMax), 0, 1), 1)

	-- dinero, reputación y nivel
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls then
		local money = ls:FindFirstChild("Money")
		local rep = ls:FindFirstChild("Rep")
		local level = ls:FindFirstChild("Level")
		refs.MoneyLabel.Text = "💰 $" .. (money and money.Value or 0)
			.. "  ⭐ " .. (rep and rep.Value or 50)
			.. "  🏆 Nv. " .. (level and level.Value or 1)
	end
end

return HUD

--============================================================
-- SHOP UI · tienda de mejoras y vehículos (panel construido por código)
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)

local HUD = require(script.Parent.HUD)

local ShopUI = {}
local panel, list

local function round(inst, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 10)
	c.Parent = inst
end

local function makeButton(parent, text, color)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 34)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113)
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextSize = 14
	b.Text = text
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.AutoButtonColor = true
	round(b, 8)
	b.Parent = parent
	return b
end

function ShopUI.Build()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "DeliveryShop"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Panel"
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(480, 560)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -240, 0.5, -280)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 30)
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Visible = false
	round(panel, 14)
	panel.Parent = gui

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 50)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "🛠️ MEJORAS Y VEHÍCULOS"
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 20
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = panel

	local close = makeButton(panel, "✕", Color3.fromRGB(80, 84, 92))
	close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0, 8)
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		panel.Visible = false
	end)

	list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -66)
	list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 56)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	list.Parent = panel

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = list
end

local function addSection(text, order)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 175)
	l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	l.TextSize = 15
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.LayoutOrder = order
	l.Parent = list
end

local function addRow(order, title, subtitle, buttonText, buttonColor, onClick)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 56)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 39, 45)
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	round(row, 10)
	row.Parent = list

	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 24)
	t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6)
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Text = title
	t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	t.TextSize = 15
	t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	t.Parent = row

	local s = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	s.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 20)
	s.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 30)
	s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	s.Text = subtitle
	s.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(175, 178, 185)
	s.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	s.TextSize = 12
	s.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	s.Parent = row

	local b = makeButton(row, buttonText, buttonColor)
	b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 11)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick)
end

local function pips(level, maxLevel)
	return string.rep("●", level) .. string.rep("○", maxLevel - level)
end

local function refresh()
	local state
	local ok = pcall(function()
		state = Remotes.GetState:InvokeServer()
	end)
	if not ok or not state or not state.Data then
		HUD.Popup({ Kind = "Fail", Title = "🛠️ TIENDA", Lines = { "No se pudo cargar la tienda." } })
		return
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local data = state.Data
	local order = 0

	-- MEJORAS
	addSection("MEJORAS DEL REPARTIDOR", order)
	for _, id in ipairs(state.UpgradeOrder) do
		order += 1
		local def = state.Upgrades[id]
		local level = data.Upgrades[id] or 0
		local maxed = level >= def.MaxLevel
		local cost = maxed and 0 or def.Costs[level + 1]
		addRow(
			order,
			def.Name .. "  " .. pips(level, def.MaxLevel),
			def.Desc,
			maxed and "MAX" or ("$" .. cost),
			maxed and Color3.fromRGB(80, 84, 92) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
			function()
				local r = Remotes.PurchaseUpgrade:InvokeServer(id)
				if r then
					HUD.Popup({ Kind = r.Ok and "Success" or "Fail", Title = r.Ok and "🛠️ MEJORA COMPRADA" or "🛠️ TIENDA", Lines = { r.Msg } })
				end
				refresh()
			end
		)
	end

	-- VEHÍCULOS
	order += 1
	addSection("VEHÍCULOS", order)
	for _, id in ipairs(state.VehicleOrder) do
		order += 1
		local def = state.Vehicles[id]
		local owned = data.Vehicles[id] == true
		local stats = "Velocidad " .. def.MaxSpeed .. " · " .. def.Desc
		addRow(
			order,
			def.Name .. (owned and " ✓" or ""),
			stats,
			owned and "USAR" or ("$" .. def.Price),
			owned and Color3.fromRGB(90, 159, 232) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
			function()
				local r
				if owned then
					r = Remotes.SpawnVehicle:InvokeServer(id)
				else
					r = Remotes.PurchaseVehicle:InvokeServer(id)
				end
				if r then
					HUD.Popup({ Kind = r.Ok and "Success" or "Fail", Title = "🚲 VEHÍCULOS", Lines = { r.Msg } })
				end
				refresh()
			end
		)
	end
end

function ShopUI.Open()
	if not panel then return end
	refresh()
	panel.Visible = true
end

return ShopUI

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- BOOTSTRAP UNIVERSAL (opcional)
-- Pega ESTE MISMO Script dentro de cualquier modelo de
-- ServerStorage/DeliveryModels (Dog, Thief, Drone, Chicken, Anomaly,
-- TrafficCar, Bike, Scooter, Moto, Car) para que sea autocontenido:
-- el modelo funcionará aunque lo clones tú mismo en workspace.
--
-- Si el modelo está vacío, se construirán bloques placeholder.
-- (Los servicios del juego también arrancan el comportamiento aunque
--  el modelo NO lleve este Script: sirve solo para uso independiente.)
--============================================================
local model = script.Parent

local ALIAS = { Bike = "Vehicle", Scooter = "Vehicle", Moto = "Vehicle", Car = "Vehicle" }
local behaviorName = ALIAS[model.Name] or model.Name

local server = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("DeliveryServer")
local behaviors = server and server:FindFirstChild("Behaviors")
local module = behaviors and behaviors:FindFirstChild(behaviorName)

if module then
	require(module).Run(model)
else
	warn("[Delivery60] No hay comportamiento '" .. behaviorName .. "' para el modelo '" .. model.Name .. "'")
end
